name: Genial Segment
description: Prime the grip with a thin stream of qi that waits in the first segments for the throw.

name: Fierce Rattle
description: Release the primed qi down the chain on a crack that makes the iron strike like a heavier weapon.

name: Eyeletbarrier
description: A short pulse of qi wakes the segments around the wielder so passing cuts glance away.

name: Raspzip
description: Step off the line as the qi is drawn back up the chain and made ready for another throw.

name: Jointslap
description: Surge qi to the tip at the end of the throw and drive it through the foe's raised guard.

name: Levering Whiplink
description: Qi runs along the chain as it winds about the foe's limb so the wrap tightens instead of slipping.

name: Buttressed Tailblade
description: Count the segments by feel at the start so the length of the chain is known without a glance.

name: Fierce Slither
description: Take half the chain into the free hand so the short remaining length strikes quickly at close range.

name: Linkpin Hammerfall
description: Pay out every segment in one long throw to touch a foe who thinks himself beyond reach.

name: Stalling Rivet
description: Catch a foe's thrust in the middle of the chain between both hands and hold it fast.

name: Jointswerve
description: Walk so that each stride matches one swing of the chain and the weapon never fouls the feet.

name: Padded Chainhead
description: Shorten the chain a hand at a time while withdrawing so the swing stays tight against the body.

name: Hingebar Slap
description: A thread of qi extends past the last segment so the tip reaches farther than its iron alone.

name: Burdening Rasp
description: Pin a loop of the chain under the foot and haul with qi so the foe's weapon is dragged out of line.

name: Guarding Spineplate
description: Stand with the rings loose over the forearm so a wrap can be thrown the moment a foe steps near.

name: Entangling Eyelet
description: Throw so that the chain winds twice about the foe's forearm and the foe cannot swing freely.

name: Jangle Scorer
description: A short flick of the tip taps the line of the foe's neck and makes the head snap back.

name: Jointprop
description: Pull against the wrap so the foe turns with it and the wielder walks around to the foe's back.

name: Veering Whiplink
description: Slide the lead foot forward as the wrap lands so the wielder closes while the foe is held.

name: Jointbuckle
description: Feed qi into a wrap so the rings tighten with each breath and the held limb loses strength.

name: Hungry Spineplate
description: While one end holds the foe's weapon arm wrapped the other end swings in with qi and strikes the ribs.

name: Jointscreen
description: Begin the spin from the wrist alone with small circles that grow into a wide disc of moving iron.

name: Stubborn Coilend
description: Keep the chain whirling flat before the body so each cut or thrust glances off the disc.

name: Raspflog
description: Open the hand at the top of a spin and let the whirling tip fly at the foe's chest.

name: Raspscreen
description: Reverse the spin suddenly so the chain slaps back against the foe's reaching arm.

name: Clay Hingebar
description: Advance on the ball of one foot in a half turn that carries the spinning disc into the foe's space.

name: Brass Slither
description: Rap the foe's flank with the spinning tip while the body stays turned away from the foe's blade.

name: Staunch Segment
description: A steady flow of qi keeps the whirling chain rigid as a disc and stops blows that would break a plain guard.

name: Duskrasp
description: Fling three quick casts from the spin one after another and drive the foe's guard back step by step.

name: Sleet Joint
description: Let the spinning chain catch a foe's weapon shaft and twist the wrist to lock the blade in the rings.

name: Shardjoint
description: Stand so the free hand is ready to gather the chain the instant a cast has spent itself.

name: Writhethwack
description: Throw from the back foot with a full extension so the tip arrives at the end of the chain's reach.

name: Haze Coilend
description: Whip the chain back in a straight pull so that it strikes aside a counter thrust on its return.

name: Raspswerve
description: Take a short check step after a cast to learn the true distance before the next throw.

name: Brass Rivet
description: A sweep close to the ground reaches the foe's lead ankle from outside the foe's blade range.

name: Hum Writhe
description: Let the returning tip catch the foe's wrist on its way home and jerk the hand off its line.

name: Draught Linkpin
description: Two casts in one breath arrive at different heights so the first draws the guard and the second strikes.

name: Static Rattle
description: Qi flows past the end of the chain and lengthens the cast by a hand's breadth to pierce an unready guard.

name: Stubborn Joint
description: Qi in the chain makes it recoil like a spring from a blocked cast and throw the foe's weapon wide.

name: Draught Writhe
description: A burst of qi in the legs carries the wielder back out of reach as the chain is gathered home.

name: Sprig Tailblade
description: Hold the barbed tip forward and low so the foe's approach must pass its point.

name: Blank Joint
description: Throw so the barb leads straight and arrives point first into the foe's unarmored gap.

name: Clay Coilend
description: A quick flick past the foe's ear makes the head turn and opens the guard on the opposite side.

name: Static Eyelet
description: Set the barb in a strap or belt and tug so the foe's body is pulled half a step forward.

name: Tethering Whiplink
description: Twist the handle to free a snagged barb at the very moment the foe braces to resist.

name: Fleet Chainhead
description: Approach on a slant so the barb is always nearer the foe than the wielder's own body.

name: Staticjoint
description: Hone the barb with qi until it slips between plates and scales to bite the flesh beneath.

name: Sleet Hingebar
description: Sink the barb into cloth or leather and wind the chain with qi so the foe cannot shake free.

name: Shard Spineplate
description: Stand light on both feet with the chain low so the legs can move before the arms do.

name: Stamp Jangle
description: A low cast seeks the foe's ankle and winds once around it as the foe steps.

name: Grit Rasp
description: Walk a half circle around the foe's tied leg so the chain draws tight behind it.

name: Gall Linkpin
description: Pull the tangled chain hard to the side and the foe's feet cross and stumble.

name: Crimson Eyelet
description: Drag the chain along the ground in a flat arc that clips the heels of a foe stepping in.

name: Rill Writhe
description: Lift the feet over fallen slack without looking down so the chain never snares the wielder.

name: Clayrattle
description: Step with qi in the soles and let the chain trail behind to catch any foe who follows.

name: Sleet Rattle
description: Qi stiffens the chain around both legs so the foe stands rooted for the length of a breath.

name: Jointscorer
description: The foe trips on the chain and falls forward onto the tip as it rises in a qi-driven blow.

name: Clayrivet
description: Carry the heavy end segment low and close so its weight steadies the whole line of the chain.

name: Stern Rivet
description: Swing the heavy end in a wide arc and let the body lean against its pull for balance.

name: Rivetscorer
description: Lift the heavy end overhead and let it drop straight down on the foe's guarding wrist.

name: Draught Jangle
description: Shuffle sideways in short steps while the heavy end swings out to hold the foe at a distance.

name: Clayjangle
description: Pour qi into the heavy end and drive it down so that bone and shield crack under the weight.

name: Sleet Slither
description: Drop the qi-weighted end over the foe's weapon and stand on the chain so the blade is pinned to the earth.
